selection_rule: Among new chunking variants, maximize dev complete_anchor_recall@10, then mean_anchor_character_coverage@5, then fewer chunks. Do not publish a full candidate unless selected pilot recall@10 and coverage@10 are at least the same-pool frozen MiniLM baseline.
default_switch: No; candidate remains explicit opt-in until Q06.5-J
